findings.title: Dynamic imports are still evaluated eagerly
findings.body: The object literal uses `import("./applecalendar")` etc. as property values, so every `import()` call runs as soon as the appStore module is evaluated. This does not provide on-demand/lazy loading of app packages: all app chunks are fetched/parsed immediately. If the goal is to import only the requested app, wrap each import in a function (e.g. `applecalendar: () => import("./applecalendar")`) or invoke `import()` at access time. It also creates promises for all apps without individual `.catch`, so a failed chunk for an unused app can become an unhandled rejection.

findings.title: Recurring cancellation calendar deletions are not awaited before final Promise.all
findings.body: In this recurring-bookings branch, the `.forEach(async (credential) => {...})` callback suspends at `await getCalendar(credential)` and at `await calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` before `apiDeletes.push(...)`. Because the async callbacks are not awaited, `apiDeletes` is still missing these calendar deletion promises when `Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` runs later, so external calendar events for the remaining recurring occurrences are not cancelled. Use a `for..of` loop and push the promises before the final await, or `await Promise.all(credentials.map(...))`.

findings.title: `await apiDeletes` does not wait for the promises in the array
findings.body: `apiDeletes` is an array of promises returned by `deleteMeeting`/`deleteEvent`. `await apiDeletes` resolves immediately with the array itself, so the paid cancellation path can return before those external integration deletions complete or fail. This should be `await Promise.all(apiDeletes)`.

findings.title: Reschedule deletions are fire-and-forget via `forEach(async)`
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {...})` is not awaited by `forEach`. The calendar/video cancellation promises are ignored, and the function continues to send emails and return before the deletions complete; rejections from the async callbacks also become unhandled. Replace this with `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` or a `for..of` loop so the cancellations are actually awaited.

findings.title: Reschedule deletion is fire-and-forget in bookings router
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {...})` is not awaited by `forEach`. The old calendar/video events are deleted in background, but the mutation proceeds to send reschedule emails and webhooks before those cancellations complete, and any rejection is unhandled. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` or a `for..of` loop to await the cancellation operations.
